Brightwater Endocrine Associates February 3, 2063
Cobalt Mutual Health, Prior Authorization Dept Re: Member Winifred Bright, member ID CM-7741-0082-A, DOB 08/22/2001 Request: continuation of simvastatin 10 mg
To Whom it May Concern,
I am writting on behalf of my patient, Ms. Bright, who has been under my care for hyperlipidemia since January 2062. On 01/06/2062 her total cholesterol was 304.1 mg/dL and LDL 180.5 mg/dL. After one year of simvastatin (started 01/27/2062, supply ended 01/27/2063) her labs drawn on 01/27/2063 show total cholesterol 192.1 and LDL 141.6, better but still above goal. Her glucose was 68.0 and eGFR 75.4.
She also has essential hypertension, obesity and chronic low back pain. Ms. Bright is 61 years old. Stopping therapy now risks rebound, so we ask that you approve a further 12 months. I enclose the lab slips (file name Bright_W_lipids_2063.pdf).
Please call (740) 555-0190 or fax (740) 555-0190 with a decision. [NAME] [FIRST_NAME] has been left blank in our template for the appeal number: APPEAL # ______.
Sincerely, Anselm Okonkwo-Reyes, MD Drafted by Caleb Tran, volunteer -- "In conclusion, this patient deserves coverage for the road ahead." cc: Winifred Bright; chart 5530-4217
